name: Lavatories
tagline: Find the nearest public toilet, wherever you are
description:
Lavatories does exactly what its name suggests: it helps you find a public toilet nearby, fast. It pulls its data from OpenStreetMap, so the results come from real, community-mapped locations rather than a closed database.

It's a small, no-nonsense open-source app for a very real everyday need, especially useful when you're out exploring an unfamiliar place.
